title: Moccamaster Won't Turn On
fullDescription: No light when switch toggled. Often power cord or thermal fuse.

title: Brew Cycle Too Long
fullDescription: Boiler tube scaled. Run cleaning cycle with descaler.

title: Coffee Brews Cold
fullDescription: Heating element failed or thermostat opened.

title: Water Leaking Internal Tube
shortDescription: Water under unit from copper tube.
fullDescription: Copper boiler tube perforated by scale. Replace tube.

title: Brew Basket Overflows
fullDescription: Drip stop closed for thermal carafe but glass model open. Or fine grind.

fixSteps.title: Open drip stop
fixSteps.instruction: Slide drip stop to open for full pots.

title: Loud Gurgling Sounds
fullDescription: Heavy scale in boiler causes loud bubbling. Descale.

title: Thermal Carafe Leaking
fullDescription: Brew-through lid gasket damaged or coffee residue.

title: Outlet Arm Sprays Unevenly
fullDescription: Outlet arm scaled. Soak in descaler.

fixSteps.title: Soak arm
fixSteps.instruction: Remove arm, soak in descaler 30 min.

title: Power Switch Cracked
fullDescription: Plastic rocker cracked. Replaceable.

fixSteps.title: Order switch
fixSteps.instruction: Replace rocker switch from Technivorm parts.

title: Hotplate Shuts Off Early
fullDescription: By design KBGV/KBGT models shut hotplate after 100 minutes per regulation.

fixSteps.title: Toggle switch
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle power switch off and on.

title: Copper Boiler Scale Buildup
shortDescription: Copper boiler showing reduced output from scale.
fullDescription: Technivorm uses a copper boiler that resists scale better than aluminum but still requires regular descaling.

fixSteps.title: Citric acid alt
fixSteps.instruction: 1tsp citric acid in 4 cups water alternative.

title: Drip-Stop Stuck Open
shortDescription: Drip-stop on KBT/KBGT not closing during brew.
fullDescription: Drip-stop allows pause-and-pour; if stuck open, brew drips during interruption.
symptoms: Coffee leaks when carafe removed mid-brew

fixSteps.title: Clean drip stop
fixSteps.instruction: Remove brew basket, rinse drip stop mechanism.

videoSearchQuery: Technivorm drip stop stuck open fix

faq.a: Lets you pour mid-brew without spillage.

title: Pulse Action Inconsistent
shortDescription: Copper element should pulse hot water; inconsistent pulse causes uneven extraction.
fullDescription: Technivorm pulse action drips water in waves. Continuous flow or no flow indicates element control issue.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: If pulse still bad, switch replacement.

faq.a: Visible waves of water — about 1 per 2 seconds.

title: Hot Plate Temperature Wrong
shortDescription: Hot plate setting incorrect causing coffee burn or cool.
fullDescription: KBGV Select offers two hot plate settings (175F or 185F). Wrong setting affects taste.

fixSteps.title: Adjust
fixSteps.instruction: Slide hot plate switch to desired setting.

title: Thermal Carafe Seal Leak
shortDescription: Thermal carafe seal worn — coffee cools quickly.
fullDescription: Thermal carafe lid seal may degrade over years; replacement restores hold.
symptoms: Coffee cools in 1 hour vs 2 hours

faq.a: Up to 4-6 hours hot when sealed properly.

title: Brew Basket Tilt Wrong
shortDescription: Brew basket flow holes not centered on carafe drip-through.
fullDescription: Technivorm basket can be set for full or partial drip stop. Wrong setting causes overflow on small batches.

fixSteps.title: Set slider
fixSteps.instruction: For 6+ cups: full open. For 4 or fewer: half.

videoSearchQuery: Technivorm brew basket drip stop setting

faq.a: Smaller batches need restricted flow for full extraction.

title: Filter Paper Collapse
shortDescription: Paper filter collapses during brew causing overflow.
fullDescription: Wrong paper filter (too thin or wrong size) collapses and causes coffee to overflow basket.

fixSteps.title: Pre-wet
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse filter with hot water before adding grounds.

faq.a: Yes — Technivorm sells permanent gold filter.

title: Power Switch Buzz
fullDescription: Older Technivorms can develop switch wear; buzz indicates contact wear.

faq.a: Yes — switch is a wear part after 10+ years.

title: Outlet Tube Crack
shortDescription: Silicone outlet tube cracked — water leaks below.
fullDescription: The silicone tube from boiler to shower can age and crack, especially near connectors.

fixSteps.title: Inspect tube
fixSteps.instruction: Lift top cover, check tube for cracks.

title: CD Grand Dose Limit
shortDescription: CD Grand 60oz unit being used with too small a dose.
fullDescription: CD Grand brews 60oz; using smaller doses without adjusting basket causes weak coffee.
videoSearchQuery: Technivorm CD Grand small batch weak
